about: St. Clair is a township in Lambton County, Ontario, along the St. Clair River between Sarnia and Wallaceburg, including communities such as Corunna, Mooretown, and Courtright. Chemical and energy industry along the river, riverside parks, and rural inland farms share the landscape—not a single city. About 14,000 people live in St. Clair Township.
